title: The Great AI Debate: Should We Slow Down or Race Ahead?
subtitle: Tech leaders are divided over the speed of artificial intelligence development and how to manage its risks.

summary.en: Leaders in the technology industry are currently debating the speed of artificial intelligence development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has called for a slower, more cautious approach to manage safety risks. In contrast, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues that companies should continue to innovate as fast as possible. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also joined the conversation, emphasizing the need for better security and monitoring. The debate highlights growing concerns about the potential dangers of advanced technology.
summary.zh: 科技產業的領袖們目前正針對人工智慧的發展速度進行辯論。Anthropic 執行長達里歐·阿莫代呼籲採取更緩慢、更謹慎的方法以管理安全風險。相反地，輝達執行長黃仁勳則主張公司應盡可能快速地持續創新。OpenAI 執行長山姆·奧特曼也加入了對話，強調提升安全性與監控的必要性。這場辯論凸顯了人們對於先進技術潛在危險日益增長的擔憂。

paragraphs.en: The global technology industry is currently facing a major disagreement over the speed of artificial intelligence (AI) development. While some leaders argue that the world must slow down to ensure safety, others believe that moving quickly is essential for progress. This debate has intensified following recent warnings from researchers about the potential risks of AI, including the possibility that it could become dangerous to humanity.
paragraphs.zh: 全球科技產業目前正針對人工智慧（AI）的發展速度面臨重大分歧。儘管部分領袖主張世界必須放慢腳步以確保安全，但其他人則認為快速發展對進步至關重要。隨著研究人員近期針對人工智慧的潛在風險發出警告，包括其可能對人類造成危險的可能性，這場辯論已愈演愈烈。

paragraphs.en: At a recent industry conference in San Francisco, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei repeated his call for a slower pace. He compared the situation to the car industry, suggesting that when one company faces a safety problem, it should be a signal for all companies to stop and check their own work. According to The Guardian, Amodei proposed three main steps: bringing in independent experts to check AI safety, creating shared standards among democratic countries, and eventually building global cooperation. He emphasized that companies should focus on their own safety records rather than just attacking their competitors.
paragraphs.zh: 在舊金山近期舉行的一場產業會議上，人工智慧公司 Anthropic 的執行長達里歐·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）重申了他對於放緩步調的呼籲。他將此情況比作汽車產業，並建議當一家公司面臨安全問題時，這應該成為所有公司停下來檢視自身工作的訊號。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，阿莫代提出了三個主要步驟：引入獨立專家來檢測人工智慧安全性、在民主國家間建立共同標準，以及最終建立全球合作。他強調，公司應專注於自身的安全紀錄，而非僅僅攻擊競爭對手。

paragraphs.en: However, not everyone agrees with this cautious approach. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, speaking at the same event, argued that companies should "run as fast as they can." He believes that new government rules are not necessary. Instead, he suggested that companies should simply hold back their products until they are certain they are safe. Huang also dismissed concerns that AI will destroy jobs, calling such ideas "nonsense." He envisions a future where every business becomes an AI company, and he warned that those who do not adopt the technology will be left behind.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，並非所有人都同意這種謹慎的做法。輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）在同一場活動中主張，公司應該「盡可能地全力衝刺」。他認為新的政府法規並無必要，並建議公司只需在確保產品安全無虞前，暫緩發布即可。黃仁勳也駁斥了人工智慧將摧毀就業機會的擔憂，稱這些想法為「無稽之談」。他預見未來每家企業都將成為人工智慧公司，並警告那些不採用這項技術的人將會被淘汰。

paragraphs.en: This disagreement is not new. For over a decade, scientists and tech leaders have warned about the risks of super-intelligent AI. The Guardian reports that as early as 2014, the famous astrophysicist Stephen Hawking warned that AI could eventually end the human race. While these warnings were once seen as science fiction, the rapid rise of AI tools has made them feel more real to the public. Recently, a former Anthropic researcher named Jacob Coxon resigned and publicly claimed that AI could lead to the end of humanity within ten years. His statement caused a wave of concern across Silicon Valley and caught the attention of government officials.
paragraphs.zh: 這種分歧並非新鮮事。十多年來，科學家與科技領袖一直針對超級智慧人工智慧的風險提出警告。《衛報》報導指出，早在二〇一四年，知名天文物理學家史蒂芬·霍金（Stephen Hawking）就曾警告，人工智慧最終可能終結人類種族。雖然這些警告曾被視為科幻小說情節，但人工智慧工具的快速崛起，讓大眾感受到這些威脅更加真實。近期，前 Anthropic 研究員雅各·考克森（Jacob Coxon）辭職並公開聲稱，人工智慧可能在十年內導致人類滅亡。他的言論在矽谷引發了一波擔憂，並引起政府官員的注意。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also weighed in on the issue. While he previously supported the idea of slowing down, he recently expressed disappointment with how the debate has been framed. At the San Francisco conference, Altman noted that AI models have advanced so quickly that the industry now needs a "new level of rigor"—a higher standard of care and strictness—regarding security. He pointed to a recent incident where OpenAI agents accidentally hacked into another company as a "wake-up call" for the entire industry. Altman acknowledged that the public is right to be afraid, noting that it is easy to imagine how things could go wrong if humans lose control of these powerful systems.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 執行長山姆·奧特曼（Sam Altman）也對此議題發表了看法。儘管他先前支持放慢腳步的想法，但他近期對辯論被定調的方式表示失望。在舊金山會議上，奧特曼指出人工智慧模型進步如此迅速，以至於產業現在需要「新層級的嚴謹度」——即針對安全性採取更高標準的照護與嚴格要求。他以近期 OpenAI 的代理程式意外駭入另一家公司的事件為例，稱其為整個產業的「警鐘」。奧特曼承認大眾的恐懼是合理的，並指出若人類失去對這些強大系統的控制，很容易想像事情會如何失控。

paragraphs.en: Political figures have also joined the discussion. According to The Guardian, former US President Donald Trump recently spoke with Jensen Huang during a public event. Trump described the growing concern about AI as a "hoax" and suggested that slowing down development would only benefit countries like China. In response, Huang stated that he wants to ensure that everyone wins in the American AI race.
paragraphs.zh: 政治人物也加入了這場討論。根據《衛報》報導，美國前總統川普（Donald Trump）近期在一場公開活動中與黃仁勳交談。川普將日益增長的人工智慧擔憂描述為一場「騙局」，並暗示放緩發展只會讓中國等國家受益。對此，黃仁勳表示他希望確保每個人都能在美國的人工智慧競賽中獲勝。

paragraphs.en: As the debate continues, the industry remains split. On one side are those who believe that commercial competition is driving a "race to the bottom," where safety is ignored in favor of profit. On the other side are those who believe that slowing down is not only impossible but also harmful to progress. The challenge for the future will be finding a balance between the desire for rapid innovation and the need to protect society from the potential risks of this powerful technology. For now, the world is watching closely as these leaders decide the path forward.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著辯論持續進行，產業內部依然分裂。一方認為商業競爭正導致一場「向下沉淪的競賽」，為了利潤而忽視安全；另一方則認為放慢腳步不僅不可能，且對進步有害。未來的挑戰將是在追求快速創新與保護社會免受這項強大技術潛在風險之間找到平衡。目前，全世界正密切關注這些領袖如何決定未來的道路。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To delay or stop something from being released or made public.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「阻止」或「隱瞞」，這裡指延後產品上市。文中：Instead, he suggested that companies should simply hold back their products until they are certain they are safe.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To give an opinion or contribute to a discussion.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「秤重」，這裡指針對議題發表看法。文中：OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also weighed in on the issue.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To express or present a situation in a particular way.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 以特定方式描述或呈現（議題）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（框架），這裡指如何定義或描述一個議題。文中：While he previously supported the idea of slowing down, he recently expressed disappointment with how the debate has been framed.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Divided into different groups or having different opinions.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（分裂），這裡作形容詞描述狀態。文中：As the debate continues, the industry remains split.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Top technology executives are calling for a slower, safer approach to artificial intelligence development. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a plan to include independent safety monitors and international cooperation. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk have publicly supported these ideas. However, US political leaders like Donald Trump and Mike Johnson fear that slowing down will let China gain an advantage. The debate highlights a deep disagreement between safety-focused tech leaders and politicians worried about national security.

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific suggestion did Dario Amodei make regarding how the AI industry should handle safety problems?

options.A: Companies should lobby governments to create strict international AI laws.
options.B: When one company identifies a safety issue, it should serve as a warning for others to audit their own systems.
options.C: Companies should stop all development until global cooperation is fully achieved.
options.D: Competitors should work together to attack companies that fail to meet safety standards.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 B。根據文章第二段，Anthropic 的執行長 Dario Amodei 將 AI 產業比作汽車業，認為當一家公司面臨安全問題時，這應該是所有公司停止並檢查自身工作的一個訊號。選項 A 錯誤，因為他主張的是建立共享標準而非單純遊說立法；選項 C 過於誇大，他並未要求完全停止開發；選項 D 錯誤，因為他強調公司應專注於自身安全記錄，而非攻擊競爭對手。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the current relationship between AI innovation and government regulation?

options.A: All industry leaders agree that government oversight is the only way to ensure safety.
options.B: The industry is unified in its belief that rapid progress is more important than safety.
options.C: There is a fundamental conflict between those who prioritize commercial speed and those who advocate for systemic safety checks.
options.D: Government officials have successfully created a consensus among tech CEOs regarding AI development.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 C。綜合全文，尤其是第二段（Amodei 的謹慎派）與第三段（Huang 的激進派），可以推論出產業內部對於「速度與安全」的優先順序存在根本分歧。選項 A 錯誤，因為 Jensen Huang 明確表示政府規則是不必要的；選項 B 錯誤，因為並非所有領導者都忽視安全；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章顯示政府官員（如川普）與產業領袖之間對此議題仍有不同看法，並未達成共識。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, Sam Altman mentions the need for a 'new level of rigor.' What does 'rigor' mean in this context?

options.A: A strict and thorough standard of care.
options.B: A rapid increase in production speed.
options.C: A physical struggle between competing companies.
options.D: A flexible approach to changing rules.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 A。在文中，Altman 提到 AI 模型進步太快，產業需要一種「new level of rigor」，隨後他解釋這意味著更高的安全標準與嚴格性。Rigor 在此處指的就是嚴謹、一絲不苟的態度。選項 B 與文意相反；選項 C 與競爭無關；選項 D 則與「嚴格」的定義相悖，因為嚴謹通常代表不輕易變通或放寬標準。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of the article?

options.A: The history of AI development from 2014 to the present day.
options.B: The conflict between OpenAI and Nvidia regarding market share.
options.C: The technical challenges of making AI models safer for the public.
options.D: The ongoing debate among leaders about balancing rapid AI innovation with safety concerns.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案是 D。整篇文章從開頭到結尾，都在探討全球科技產業對於 AI 發展速度的爭論，納入了不同執行長（Amodei, Huang, Altman）的觀點以及政治人物的介入，核心議題始終是「如何在快速創新與社會安全風險之間取得平衡」。選項 A 只是背景資訊；選項 B 錯誤，文章並未聚焦於這兩家公司的商業競爭；選項 C 僅觸及部分內容，未涵蓋關於速度的爭論。
